facts.statement: Vectisuchus is a genus of pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian.
facts.quote: Vectisuchus is a genus of pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian

facts.statement: Vectisuchus fossils are known from the Early Cretaceous-age Wealden Group of the Isle of Wight, England.
facts.quote: known from the Early Cretaceous-age Wealden Group of the Isle of Wight, England

facts.statement: The type specimen, SMNS 50984, was found in 1977.
facts.quote: The type specimen, SMNS 50984, was found in 1977

facts.statement: The type species is V. leptognathus.
facts.quote: The type species is V. leptognathus

facts.statement: Vectisuchus belongs to the parent group Dyrosauroidea.
Vectisuchus lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages, from 125.77 to 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Vectisuchus was a small, fish-eating crocodylomorph with a narrow, elongate snout and relatively long forearms.
rejected.quote: It was a small, piscivorous crocodylomorph with a narrow, elongate snout, and relatively long forearms
